# `filter`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
filter(expr, func)
```

Filters the input array using the given predicate.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT filter(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x % 2 == 1);
```

Result:

```text
[1,3]
```

```sql
SELECT filter(array(0, 2, 3), (x, i) -> x > i);
```

Result:

```text
[2,3]
```

```sql
SELECT filter(array(0, null, 2, 3, null), x -> x IS NOT NULL);
```

Result:

```text
[0,2,3]
```
